eula.body: OptiMax is a free app by ER7 Studio: every feature is available to everyone, with no keys or payments. Decompiling, modifying or redistributing the app under a different name is prohibited. The app is provided “as is”, without warranties: create a restore point before changing system settings. Full text — docs/EULA.md.
privacy.body: OptiMax works fully offline and collects no personal data: no telemetry, accounts or network requests. Only settings and the change log are stored locally, in the app data folder. Nothing is ever sent anywhere. Full text — docs/PRIVACY.md.
task.clean_temp_user.d: Cleans %TEMP% — installer leftovers, app caches, temporary data. Files in use are skipped.
task.clean_temp_windows.d: Cleans C:\Windows\Temp. Requires administrator rights; active files are skipped.
task.clean_recycle.d: Permanently deletes Recycle Bin content on all drives and reports the freed space.
task.clean_browser.d: Cleans cache, Code Cache and GPU Cache of Edge and Chrome. Cookies, passwords and history stay untouched.
task.clean_thumbnails.d: Cache of obsolete image thumbnails. Locked files will be removed after a reboot.
task.clean_crashdumps.d: Removes CrashDumps, Minidumps and WER reports (ReportQueue/ReportArchive).
task.clean_updates.d: Deletes downloaded update packages from SoftwareDistribution\Download. They will be re-downloaded only when needed.
task.clean_prefetch.d: Cleans C:\Windows\Prefetch. Windows will rebuild the cache on next program launches.
task.clean_winold.d: Deletes the previous Windows version folder — often tens of gigabytes. Irreversible: rolling back to the old version becomes impossible.
task.clean_winsxs.d: DISM /StartComponentCleanup — removes superseded update components. Long operation in a console window.
task.order_desktop.d: Creates folders right on the desktop and sorts program shortcuts (Office ones separately) and files into them: images, documents, videos…; system icons stay put.
task.order_downloads.d: Sorts downloaded files into folders inside Downloads itself; files newer than 24 h are left alone.
task.order_names.d: Removes double and extra spaces from file names on the desktop, in Downloads and Documents. Names are not shortened — only tidied.
task.order_photos.d: Moves images and videos from the Pictures root into year subfolders (by file modified date).
task.perf_power_ultimate.d: Enables the Ultimate Performance plan (no CPU frequency limits, no device latency). The previous plan is remembered for undo.
task.perf_visualfx.d: Switches Windows to “Adjust for best performance” (no transparency or shadows). One-click undo.
task.perf_telemetry_off.d: Disables the DiagTrack service, AllowTelemetry policy and data collection tasks. Less background load and network traffic.
task.perf_bg_apps_off.d: Disables Store apps running in background (GlobalUserDisabled + policy). Reversible via undo.
task.perf_menu_delay.d: Removes the artificial menu open delay (400 ms) and taskbar animations — the UI reacts instantly.
task.perf_hibernate_off.d: Frees disk space equal to RAM size (hiberfil.sys). Fast startup is also disabled.
task.perf_sysmain.d: Disables preloading programs into memory. Useful on SSD and 8+ GB RAM machines; on HDD it may be worse.
task.perf_game_tweaks.t: Gaming tweaks (Game Mode + Game DVR off)
task.perf_game_tweaks.d: Enables Game Mode, disables Game DVR background recording — fewer lags in games.
task.perf_gpu_sched.d: Enables HwSchMode=2 — lowers frame latency on compatible GPUs (Win10 2004+). Reboot required.
task.perf_search_off.d: Stops the WSearch service. Start menu search works, but file and Outlook search won’t. Great for weak machines.
task.net_dns_flush.d: Resets DNS and NetBIOS caches — helps with website access errors and after DNS changes.
task.net_tcp_tune.d: Restores autotuning=normal, enables RSS, disables heuristics. Undoes the damage of “miracle tweaks” from the internet.
task.net_dns_fast.d: Sets DNS 1.1.1.1 / 1.0.0.1 on the active adapter. Previous settings are remembered.
task.net_dns_reset.d: Restores receiving DNS servers from router/DHCP on all active adapters.
task.net_nagle_off.d: TCPNoDelay=1 and TcpAckFrequency=1 on active interfaces — lower ping in online games.
task.net_winsock_reset.d: netsh winsock reset — fixes a broken network after VPN/antivirus issues. System reboot required. Irreversible.
task.sys_restore_point.d: Recommended before any changes: Checkpoint-Computer with an OptiMax description. Can be rolled back with standard Windows tools.
task.sys_sfc.d: sfc /scannow in a console window — finds and repairs corrupted system files. Long operation.
task.sys_dism.d: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth — repairs the Windows component store. Long, in a console window.
task.sys_chkdsk.d: chkdsk C: /scan — quick file system check without reboot. Result in the console window.
task.sys_update_open.d: Quick jump to ms-settings:windowsupdate — check for updates manually.
